A preliminary bimodal picture of DSFGs is appearing, where lensed sources are indicative of typically central dusty star-bursts, found in other surveys to be rotationally stable, while the weakly- or unlensed HyLIRGs could represent turbulent massive star-forming events driven by unstable galaxy kinematics and clumpy gas flows.
